_source: Generated 2026-09-02 from the deployed Apps Script build (NSGP Intake Form v1, Version 24): the FIELDS array in Code.gs for key/section/label/order, and the element type per data-key in Index.html for kind. Edit this file by hand from now on; the Python generator is retired for this form. 2026-09-03: Programs grew from 6 to 20 rows (the page shows rows as they are added); 3.2.1 retired in favour of the Programs tab and kept as meta so old answers still read. 2026-09-03: loc<n>_infra added per site; resp_q_4_6 retired as meta. 2026-09-08: wl_f<n>_ma_on / wl_f<n>_ma_amount added (M&A line on each facility's wish list, on by default).
_kinds: text | textarea | select | upload | meta. meta keys (_status) are written by the server, never by the page.

2.1 Describe your organization's ideology and the public positions it is known for. Name the specific theological, social, or political stances your organization holds publicly, especially any that have drawn criticism, protest, or outside attention. Examples: an affirming or Reconciling stance on inclusion, a pro-life or pro-choice position, support for Israel or for Palestinian rights, refugee resettlement or immigrant sanctuary work, traditional teaching on marriage, racial justice advocacy, or a denominational position that has put your organization in the public eye. Organizations across the entire spectrum receive NSGP awards. Be specific and honest; this is the question the risk narrative is built on. Please include a link to your statement of faith, beliefs, or values.
